# Unknown IITians

> Unknown IITians (www.unknowniitians.com) is an Indian online education platform for IIT Madras BS degree (IITM BS) students and aspirants, with JEE and NEET material as well. It offers free subject-wise notes, previous year question papers (PYQs), grade, CGPA and marks calculators, live courses for the IITM BS Qualifier and Foundation levels, and Quiz Space, a site for practising IITM BS previous year papers online with answer keys and timed mock tests.

## What it offers for IITM BS students
- Free week-wise notes for IITM BS Data Science and Electronic Systems subjects, organised by branch, level (Qualifier, Foundation, Diploma, Degree) and subject.
- Free previous year question papers: Qualifier, Quiz 1, Quiz 2, OPPE and End Term.
- Quiz Space (https://quizspace.unknowniitians.com): the same papers practised online, question by question, on an exam-like screen with answer keys and explanations. Free with a Google sign-in.
- Free calculators for all four IITM BS branches (Data Science and Applications, Management and Data Science, Aeronautics and Space Technology, Electronic Systems): a grade calculator and score checker, a CGPA calculator and a marks predictor, using each course's published grading formula.
- Live IITM BS Qualifier and Foundation courses with lectures, practice and doubt-solving.
- Study groups and communities for IITM BS students.

## Key pages
- [IITM BS degree preparation](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/iitm-bs): notes, PYQs, tools, courses, news and dates in one place.
- [IITM BS notes](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/iitm-bs/notes): free subject-wise PDF notes.
- [IITM BS PYQs](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/iitm-bs/pyqs): previous year question papers.
- [Quiz Space](https://quizspace.unknowniitians.com): practise IITM BS PYQs online with answer keys.
- [IITM BS grade calculator and score checker](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/iitm-bs/tools/grade-calculator)
- [IITM BS CGPA calculator](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/iitm-bs/tools/cgpa-calculator)
- [IITM BS marks predictor](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/iitm-bs/tools/marks-predictor)
- [IITM BS live courses](https://www.unknowniitians.com/courses/category/iitm-bs)
- [IITM BS syllabus](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/iitm-bs/syllabus) and [important dates](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/iitm-bs/dates)
- [Best IITM BS study resources: a comparison guide](https://www.unknowniitians.com/best-iitm-bs-resources)
- Subject pages: one page per subject tying together its notes, previous year papers, calculators and batches, at https://www.unknowniitians.com/iitm-bs/<branch>/<level>/<subject>, for example [Mathematics for Data Science II](https://www.unknowniitians.com/iitm-bs/data-science/foundation/mathematics-for-data-science-ii).
- [JEE preparation](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/jee) and [NEET preparation](https://www.unknowniitians.com/exam-preparation/neet)

## Frequently asked questions
- Where can I find IITM BS previous year question papers? On Unknown IITians' PYQs page, free, by subject, exam and year, and online on Quiz Space with answer keys.
- Is there a free IITM BS grade calculator or score checker? Yes: the Unknown IITians grade calculator covers all four IITM BS branches and shows total score and letter grade.
- Are IITM BS notes free? Yes, all notes on Unknown IITians are free to download.
- Does Unknown IITians offer IITM BS Qualifier coaching? Yes, live Qualifier and Foundation courses, plus free notes and previous year papers.
